segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text:
Hi Mark,

We’re planning for 62 seats and a June 17 go-live. Can you send the final quote with implementation included? Finance wants the annual total and payment terms before they cut a PO.

Dana

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dana,

Attached is the quote for 62 seats, standard support, and the remote implementation package. Annual subscription is $48,900 and implementation is $6,000, net 30.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. One thing: the quote shows $48,900, but your note yesterday had the subscription at $44,500 if we kept the start date in June. Should I have purchasing use that number?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
Yes, use $44,500 for the subscription and $6,000 for implementation. The order form may still show the earlier total for a bit; send the PO against $50,500 and I’ll get the form lined up on my side after.

Mark

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Purchasing also asked whether the 62 seats can be split across our operations and finance teams, or if we need separate agreements.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: One agreement is fine. We’ll set up two admin groups under the same account, and your team can assign the 62 seats across both groups as needed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Please make the start date June 17 and the invoice date July 1. Our AP team won’t process anything dated before the new fiscal month.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text:
No problem. I’ll set contract start as June 17 and first invoice date as July 1, net 30. Once the PO is in, we can schedule kickoff for the week of June 10.

Mark
